We love companion pet hospital!! We have a cat with mega colon and they have been so helpful and gentle with him. They also love our Pom :)
Hi, Sarah. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!
Great team from the check-in to the exam room. I'm so grateful for their skill and compassion. If you want a vet who truly cares about your pet, I can't recommend this team enough.
Hi, Mistie. We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review!

Really did not have a warm or welcoming experience when coming here, and then compacted by condescending and rude communication. I expect vets to love and be warm to animals…

Also EXTREMELY overpriced. Rather go back to center city vet even though its a little further from me now

My dog and I love coming here mia is so Lovely and helpful
Thank you !
They made room for me with a last minute appointment for my Louie. From the front desk to being seen by the vet, everyone was exceptionally nice and understanding.
Hi, Dj. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us.
This is an excellent vet! They run things smoothly and it’s always easy to get an appointment. The staff is great, all the way from the front staff to the vets. Highly recommend

I love this vet:) whenever I’m having a problem I call, and I’m able to speak to the vet and get any advice and reassurance. All the staff are so sweet and I trust them!!!  We moved neighborhoods but I still drive down here for the amazing customer service and support
I can’t thank everyone who works here enough for their kindness and compassion. We’re so grateful that our animals are in such good care here.
The only vet that can handle my spicy kitty! Everyone is so compassionate and kind. Cannot recommend enough!
Hi, Andrew. Thank you for taking the time to review your experience with us!

Companion Pet Hospital offers great care. Bella is 14 and she has been in the hospitals care for years. The team is consistently kind, knowledgeable, and helpful. Dr Shakory is a gem! She has been very informative and reassuring about Bella’s condition and progression as she ages. She has a wonderful bedside manner and is warm and available for questions.
The best vet in town :)
My pup has been coming here since we got here and we’ve had great experiences every time! The staff is kind and test results come back quickly.

This is Max I have been going to companion pet hospital for close to 8 years they are great here they treat Max great The staff is really good and the Doctors always treat Max with the best care I put all my trust in them would definitely recommend they are awesome!!!!! Mr.Burns!!!!
Always friendly, quick and efficient! Recommend.
The people here are so super friendly and very professional. They took great care of our cat, and we will be coming back!

The most caring, friendly, and professional vets we've ever been to (and we've been to a lot of them over the years). Have now taken our dog and 2 cats to Companion and will continue to recommend them to all of our friends and neighbors in the Philadelphia area.
Friendly staff. Doctor was very thorough and spent time answering questions. Quality experience for both myself and dog
We love Companion Pets. We’ve been coming here with several different cats over the last 15 years.
Got a new October back LOL
Hi, Samantha. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!
Hi, Victoria. We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review!
Everyone is friendly and caring!
Hi, Charlene. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us.
Dr. Shakory and Shauna were so kind and gentle with my dog for her dental procedure. They explained the process and recovery very well.
Hi, Andrea. Thank you for taking the time to review your experience with us!
Everyone I came across from the staff to doctors were very friendly, helpful and informative in every way.
We’ve always had a great experience with the vets at this spot. And they are responsive to emails when any issues come up, and always check on your pet after appointments or procedures.
Efficient service with friendly, caring staff and great advice.

The staff @ Companion are always kind, professional, and genuinely caring throughout every visit. I really appreciate their compassion and attention to detail & would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy vet.

My dog gets SO excited to go to companion. We live in the neighborhood and can’t even walk by without him trying to go inside. The staff is always pleasant, welcoming, and gentle with their patients. The doctors never make me feel pressured into doing/suggest unnecessary treatments. Highly recommend taking your pets here for care!
Lisa is one of the best groomers around! Franklin loves getting baths with her!

We love Companion!  They take such good care of my baby Loviefluffy! She is well managed with her early thyroid disease and she’s doing great at 12! Companion staff is wonderful with her!  They are all so kind and calm and loving.

They treated us and our pet very well and were patient in explaining things to us. followup; we've recently taken her in for minor surgery and their accommodation to our concerns/questions was exceptional. The staff continues to provide excellent service.
Very caring and kind professionals. Thorough and respectful.
Hi, Mary. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review.
I have been taking Penny to CPH since she was a puppy, they have always taken excellent care of her.

The entire staff at VCH are the best! They are emphatic, caring and have consistently addressed all my pets needs with concern and care over the last 12 years. My dog has been a patient there from when he just a puppy.

Such great and caring people work here! Been taking my dog here since I adopted him 5 years ago and as much as he hates getting shots and bloodwork, he still loves the kind people taking care of him. They’re very thorough and always follow up after every appointment to see how he is doing.
The team at Companion is amazing! They treat your pets as if they were their own.

In my opinion, they are very expensive, and I also think they are too quick to jump to the most expensive and invasive treatment instead of trying more supportive care options first.

I agree with recent reviewers who say their prices have gotten out of hand over the past few years. Not sure if they switched ownership or what.
Hi, Elaine. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!
Hi, Emerson. We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review!
Great and compassionate staff that make our cat care a breeze. Strong endorse!
Hi, Kevin. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review.

When I first rescued my Petey I was looking for a new vet that would show compassion and give good care that he deserved. My friend recommended Companion pet hospital. From the time that I walked in for the original appointment to my current appointments now everyone is welcoming, professional, and caring of the animals. They don’t just see them as $$$ they see them as their own pets. Petey is sometimes nervous, but when he sees your faces that work there he instantly calms down. I know he’s in good hands and the care that he is getting is the top of the line if you’re looking for a new vet to give your pets to care that they deserve and need look no further companion pet hospital is the best out there!
Excellent care, from a friendly and compassionate staff

Our Great Dane love bug just had a spay and gastropexy and dental cleaning last week at Companion pet hospital. I cannot say enough good things about them. From the pre-surgery communication to the surgery day to the post-op follow up calls, we were so impressed with the kindness and care they showed us and our girl. Dr. Majeska cared for our first giant breed baby 15 years ago and we really wanted her to do the surgery for our girl now. We were lucky enough to book with her again and were quickly reminded why we loved our experience so much. Everyone we interacted with here was kind, compassionate (I may have sobbed at drop off) and seem to genuinely care about taking care of our girl. We received a call from the Dr. immediately after surgery and then photos from recovery. As a side note, the price we paid for all three services was reasonable and more than fair considering everything she had done and the above and beyond service we received. We cannot say enough good things about Companion Pet Hospital. 10/10 recommend :)
The customer service and pet care at CPH is outstanding.  I couldn’t recommend them higher.  Thank you CPH for your continued support and care for Phoenix & Rogue!

Everyone who works here cares very deeply about the pets safety happiness and health. I've never felt pressured to add on any extra tests or treatments without a very thoughtful reason.

Even in the waiting room, they are polite, informative, and treat all who walk through the door with respect and dignity. It's an amazing place to have in the neighborhood.

We have 3 cats that we've taken here to get check ups / vaccines and they took good care of them but when I called to bring in a friendly stray to get a check up for an injury the receptionist seemed hesitant to book an appointment and then hung up on me while I was asking a question.

I get not wanting to see a stray which is fine but at least be up front about it and dont be rude and hang up on people. I would have paid for the appointment in full. Guess I need to find a new spot for my 3 cats since I dont want to do business with a company that won't even direct me to a proper place to seek care.
Hi, Jackie. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!
So everyone at Companion Pet Hospital have been nothing short of amazing. I torture the hell out of them but they don't seem to care. They're only goal is to help me get my Marilyn Monroe healthy

Dr McCafferty was very kind and knowledgeable regarding end of life comfort measures for my dog. She listened carefully and offered excellent suggestions on how to help him  attain a level of comfort. Highly recommend this practice. Have been going here for years. Always a great experience.

Since he was a puppy I’ve trusted Companion Pet Hospital to be the sole care providers for my best friend. Now after almost 11 years I can say that the staff of CPH are a huge part of his life and mine, with unparalleled service and treatment that’s only matched by their warmth, kindness and compassion. From major life threatening emergencies to monthly grooming sessions and everything in between, our friends at CPH are the best of the best. Thank you for your years of service and for always keeping the cookie jar full
Great hospital! Considering I have a difficult dog who hates the vet and other dogs, they were very sympathetic and helpful with our old grumpy man!
They are so caring and sweet. Big thanks always!!!

Couldn't be happier with the care, professionalism, and speed at which i was helped as a first time visitor. Companion's reputation is as good as it is for a reason and I couldn't recommend them enough.
Appt. Was easy. Everyone very kind to my dog. Everyone courteous every time we visit.
It's expensive. But I think all Vets are owned by investment groups now.

Nicest people ever and were so amazing to our dogs Finley and Cooper. Everyone from the front desk folks to the doctors cared about our pets and their health as much as we did. So glad we bring our dogs here now.

Always a pleasure coming here for yearly check-ups and vaccinations for my cat. Staff is super friendly and responsive! They always follow up with any concerns I’ve had in the past for my cat. Really glad to be recommended this place since getting my cat four years ago!
Hi, Adam. We appreciate you taking the time to leave us a review!

Prices are out of control. DO NOT recommend. They used to be reasonably priced many years ago, but now its just shy of $700 for a routine dog checkup visit. Did they get purchased by a PE firm pushing these insulting prices?
Hi, Sarah. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us.

The prices are very high, and they charge you for an exam every time you go. I took my cats in for vaccinations, and three weeks later they had to go back for a booster shot. This is just a way to get more money out of you, and then they did the same exam they had done three weeks earlier, again, just to charge you more.  They always find ways to charge you extra for unnecessary things.
Hi, Michelle. Thank you for taking the time to review your experience with us!
Hi, Hollie. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review.
Hi, Teddy. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!

I’ve been going to Companion for almost 2 years and am always blown away with how kind and amazing the staff are. They take time to explain what’s going on and never make me feel bad for asking so many questions.

I cannot in good conscience recommend this vet practice to anyone in the current economic climate. I’ve been going here for maybe 8 years, and prices have just gotten completely out of control since the pandemic but especially in the last 2 years. The care and staff are great, but we cannot afford to keep taking our pets here. It’s a shame because we live so close and we want to support local businesses in our neighborhood,  but routine visits shouldn’t cost over $500 for a single cat. Additionally, to get 2 male kittens fixed we were quoted between $900-1,500 total for the procedures. We ended up taking them to PAWS for $150 total instead.

We want the best care for our animals but can’t help but feel a little taken advantage of. We will sadly be taking our cats elsewhere moving forward.
Transaction was easy, fees are high
Caring Vets for you and your pets.
Hi, Bill. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review.
Hi, Yulissa. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!
They went above and beyond. They also have a small parking.

We take our cats and our very needy dog here and have for years. Companion has always been stellar - my dog is a large (anxious) breed and struggles with vet visits. Companion is always so kind and comes up with creative and flexible solutions to help him when he isn't feeling well. I recently moved out of Philly and Companion was still my go to vet because of how they great they are.

I've been taking my cat to Companion Pet Hospital for about 4 years now and everyone - the staff, techs, doctors and groomers - has always been great.  They go above and beyond to inquire about and follow up on my cat's health and comfort, they're very thorough in conducting exams, and have shared a lot of helpful advice for his care.  My cat has done well under their care, and I definitely recommend CPH.

Companion has been helping me deal with some recurring issues with my pet. Every time they have gone above and beyond, always check in the next day, and make sure I have all of the information needed. I haven’t had a bad experience yet and we have seen multiple front desk assistants, techs, and doctors (all have been amazing)!

Every doctor we’ve worked with at Companion has been wonderful but the big standout with our experience at Companion is tech Jon! He’s always so kind to us and shows a love for our pets that makes us so comfortable.
Hi, Deema. We appreciate the rating, and we are grateful for the opportunity to serve you (and your pet companion)!

I wish I could give this vet office more than 5 stars. They have helped my senior cat so much, and when my little guy started showing signs of kitty dementia they were so compassionate towards me and my grieving process. They are super great about communicating through email, and every time my cat needed some kind of treatment they worked really hard to make sure everything was affordable for me. I'm sad I had to find a new vet because I moved out of Philadelphia, these guys are really the best. Thank you for taking such good care of my silly orange best friend!!
Hi, J.. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Hi, Trey. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

first time dog owner, picked this place cuz it was a block away and had pretty good reviews.
Everyone was AMAZING, friendly and caring. They all genuinely were invested in the job and I look forward to coming back for years to come. Shout out to the front desk!
Prices also seemed extremely reasonable especially for Philly.
Nice place .
Always excellent. I moved to West Philly and still trek down here for them.
Hi, Juliana. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

Have been taking my cat to Companion for a few years now, but today they really knocked it out of the park. My mom and I found a stray dog in her neighborhood that had obviously been roaming the street for some time. We weren’t sure what to do long term, but wanted to make sure the pup got checked out. Brought the little lady in today and not only did she receive excellent care, but the team at Companion made sure I had all the information needed to make an educated decision on how to move forward with this stray. Every staff member we encountered seemed genuinely invested in the dog’s well being. As a result of the visit, we decided to go ahead and keep the little girl and are calling her Dottie! Huge thank you to the team at Companion Pet Hospital!!

I’ve spent thousands of dollars at this particular vet and they just cancelled my dog’s sick visit last minute. I took my sick dog to the allotted appointment only to be turned away and gaslit since they had the wrong phone number for me in their system.

They sent me an email to go to an emergency vet instead and listed vets on the other side of town instead of the emergenct vet right in our neighborhood.

I used to own a pet supply store in this city so I’ve met many vets and staff. The way I was treated today was cold and uncaring and unlike any other vet I’ve been to. I’d skip this place if you have a sick animal.

Please give us a call at (215) 703-7387 at your earliest convenience, we look forward to speaking with you soon. Thank you.

We felt that our pet received great care during his last visit. We are grateful to have a local vet who takes the time to hear our concerns and love our pet as much as we do. It is a little bit pricey here, but the convenience and quality of care if worth it to us!

Companion consistently has the best vet service for my senior cats & I have tried many clinics in the city. Very thorough. It’s easy to schedule/reschedule appointments online and they are on time. Super responsive by phone/email and their pricing is reasonable and transparent. And there’s parking!!
Hi, Susan. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

my pup loves these folks
they r all animal lovers and unbelievably kind
i highly recommend them
